rationale.MatrixSpec: Strong source-referenced repository-wide design with explicit uncertainty boundaries and useful runbook material. It correctly identifies ohos_nweb, ohos_adapter, ohos_glue, bundle.json, bridge generation, tests, and deployment concerns. However, it is less focused on ohos_nweb itself than requested and spends substantial space on arkweb_utils, Native Messaging, and version strategy, so key ohos_nweb files such as BUILD.gn, nweb_helper.cpp, nweb_config_helper.cpp, surface adapters, crashpad, etc/web_config.xml, and exported inner kits are not covered with the same precision as the sampled source warrants.
rationale.CodeWiki community: Best focused package for ohos_nweb among the markdown sets. It maps include/src/etc/prebuilts, NWebHelper, NWebConfigHelper, NWebSurfaceAdapter, WebViewValue, crashpad, C API download forwarding, and QA navigation in a developer-friendly way, and it includes many direct file and line references. It matches the sampled source structure and BUILD.gn targets better than MatrixSpec. Weaknesses are repeated synthetic module splits over the same include/src folders, some ungrounded operational/security claims, and fewer build/test references than the repository evidence provides.
rationale.DeepWiki: Most complete and best grounded overall. It covers the full repository while still including dedicated NWebHelper orchestration, ArkWebCore HAP distribution, build/code generation, ohos_nweb/BUILD.gn, nweb_helper.cpp, ohos_interface glue, bundle.json, tests, adapters, and platform integration with source links to exact files and ranges. Its architecture view aligns with the sampled README, bundle.json, BUILD.gn, and ohos_nweb source. It is somewhat broad for an ohos_nweb-focused judgment and does not always mark uncertainty, but its source grounding and cross-layer coverage are clearly strongest.

MatrixSpec: Over-broad relative to the requested ohos_nweb focus; much of the document centers on arkweb_utils, Native Messaging, and repository-level process.

Does not deeply enumerate actual ohos_nweb BUILD.gn outputs such as web_configs, libnweb output_name arkweb_core_loader, nweb_hap, web_config, web.para, alias/context-menu, and chrome_crashpad_handler.
Some module relationships are inferred at a high level rather than tied to sampled function bodies in nweb_helper.cpp, nweb_config_helper.cpp, and surface adapters.
CodeWiki community: Several module pages duplicate the same include/src scope under different names, which weakens module validity.
Some claims about sandboxing, minidump upload paths, production crash handling, and dynamic library source validation are plausible but not consistently backed by sampled source evidence.
Operational coverage is lighter on bundle.json build integration, fuzz/unittest targets, bridge generation, and repository-level config than the source sample supports.
DeepWiki: Very broad repository wiki; some sections dilute the ohos_nweb focus with NAPI, CJ, adapters, resource scheduling, and advanced WebView APIs.
Generated HTML is harder to consume as an offline document set than the markdown alternatives.
Uncertainty boundaries are weaker than MatrixSpec; it presents many source-grounded statements confidently rather than separating confirmed facts from inference.

fairness_notes: Scoring used a bounded sample: top-level README, ohos_nweb README/BUILD.gn, bundle.json, nweb_helper.h/cpp, path/content searches for ohos_nweb/NWeb, and representative docs from each set. DeepWiki was credited for breadth only where it remained source-linked to real repository files, and penalized mildly for being less narrowly focused on ohos_nweb.
